glossary.specification repository: the private repository Ultra-Brain-Legacy (specifications and judgment records)
glossary.Owner: the individual user who makes the final decisions for this project
glossary.guard kernel: the main repository's own check layer that judges each development act
glossary.keyed witness: a signature that the same user cannot forge
glossary.Owner act: an act only the Owner may make: create the guard, lift a seal, lift a lock, resolve a judgment hold, switch the adversarial audit off, recover

decision_path: checkpoints at acts that already ask for Windows Hello: stopped before implementation (the guard had no such act)
bind the guard's Owner route to Windows Hello: reported before implementation that the three same-user rewrites stay open

built.signed: the repository, the act, the line number and the hash of the position the act follows
built.public_key_source: the Windows Hello container, every time
refused: an Owner line without a valid signature
a chain that does not start with a signed creation or recovery
built.gesture_taken: before the writer lock, only when the act would proceed

bench.native_engine_round_trip: not run: Windows Smart App Control blocked this build's engine image; a second image of the same source is not tried again

kernel_self_audit.flag_acted_on: the new test file was not plain (code at import, one skip); changed in 8262adb; the final audit no longer flags it

limits: a forged tail after the last Owner line
a rollback to any earlier signed point, the creation point and signatures that outlived a recovery included
an Owner line's own content is not signed
the Windows Hello dialog does not show what is signed
a signature made for an act the guard then refused remains valid at its position (it can be reused there)
not_run: whether deleting the key asks a gesture
